requests.prompt:
EDIT THE PROVIDED REFERENCE into a production 2D HD combat sprite sheet for a French Mass Effect 1 fan RPG. The reference crew-atlas.png is 1536x1024 with 8 people. Select ONLY KAIDAN ALENKO, the human man in the THIRD cell of the TOP row, pixel rectangle x768 y0 width384 height512. Do not depict any of the other seven characters. Preserve that Kaidan identity: adult athletic realistic human male, warm olive skin, short dark brown-black hair swept upward at front, clean-shaven serious face, navy-blue and muted blue-grey Alliance military armor with pale scuffed steel-blue shoulder, forearm and knee plates, charcoal flexible undersuit, black armored boots. Preserve his existing ME1 costume from this reference. NO Shepard N7 insignia or red-white stripes, NO later ME3 blue-officer redesign, no new emblems or helmet.
Create ONE transparent RGBA landscape atlas, ideally 1536x1024, FOUR separate full-body key poses of the SAME Kaidan, arranged as a generous separated 2x2 sheet. Top left: AIM — three-quarter facing right, stable feet, holding and aiming a compact generic science-fiction pistol toward right with two hands. Top right: POWER — same three-quarter body, one hand extended in a neutral tech/biotic-action gesture, the pistol safely lowered in the other hand; no visible glow or energy effect, the gesture itself is all that is drawn. Bottom left: HIT — same armor and identity, recoiling backward from a non-graphic impact, knees flexed, entire body and both boots visible, not sitting. Bottom right: DOWN — the same fully armored body lying horizontally on its side, head to the left and boots to the right, harmless knocked-out pose, no injury or blood. Maintain the SAME man's anatomy, head, exact armor panel design and palette in every frame, not four different men. Use at least 25px transparent outer padding around every figure and clear empty gutters between figures. All entire heads, fingers, boots and weapons stay inside their individual separated areas; no overlapping figures or cropped edges. Standing poses use consistent anatomical scale and realistic adult proportions. Down pose must keep the same body proportions and not become a tiny icon. Fixed orthographic three-quarter camera, soft top-left diffuse studio light, detailed pre-rendered HD JRPG sprite art, material rendering and clean silhouette matching the source. Isolated figures on TRUE transparent background, no painted checkerboard, no floor or cast shadow plate, no vignette, colored backdrop, text, pose labels, frame borders, UI, signatures, watermark or incorporated VFX. This is four fixed prototype key poses, not a complete animation. Return the generated PNG unchanged for direct integration.
requests.rejectionReason: Visible pixels of aim and hit overlap their rectangular crops.
